fix_summary: validate_email uses "@" in email without guarding against a missing contact_email, so when partners omit it (email is None) this triggers a TypeError. Also, unlike other validators, it returns a boolean instead of raising ValidationError. Fix by checking for presence and format and raising ValidationError (e.g., 'missing contact email' or 'invalid contact email') instead of performing membership on None.
suggested_test: Add a test that submits an order dict without 'contact_email' and asserts that validate_email(order) raises ValidationError('missing contact email'). Optionally also assert that validate(order) returns False when 'contact_email' is missing.
